# clavis admin backup

<p class="cli-lead">Create an encrypted consistent database backup</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin backup [flags]
```

</div>

Write an encrypted, consistent snapshot of the database (SQLite
`VACUUM INTO` or `pg_dump`). The backup contains wrapped organization
keys, so keep the root key separately: without it the backup can't be
read.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin backup --out clavis-backup.enc
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Docker</p>

```sh
docker exec clavis clavis admin backup --out /data/backup.enc
docker cp clavis:/data/backup.enc ./
```
